Arjun Bark Powder Exporter: Terminalia Arjuna Bark Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Arjun bark powder is the finely milled stem bark of Terminalia arjuna. Tradenest Naturals supplies it in bulk to herbal supplement makers, tea blenders, extract manufacturers and Ayurvedic formulation brands in the USA, UK, Canada and Europe. We are an FSSAI licensed food business and IEC registered exporter based in Surat, India, and we work as an arjun bark powder bulk supplier for buyers who need the same material from one order to the next. Most of our wholesale arjun bark powder customers are formulators. They want a predictable particle size, a clean brown colour and a powder that runs well on capsule and blending lines. We mill the dried bark into a fine powder and sieve it to 80-100 mesh, so it blends evenly into dry mixes, tea cuts and extraction feedstock.

How We Process Arjun Bark

The work starts with the raw bark. We select it carefully and source it from trusted growers and collectors in India. Each lot is checked on arrival for botanical identity, appearance and dryness. The bark is then cleaned, dried and fine milled under hygienic conditions. Nothing else is added to the powder. Pricing matters for a commercial ingredient, so we keep the supply chain short and simple. That lets us quote a fair arjun bark powder bulk price for trial lots and repeat containers alike. Our minimum order is 5 Kg, which suits pilot batches and new product development. When you need a steady partner as a terminalia arjuna bark powder manufacturer, we can plan supply around your production calendar.

Key Technical Specifications

Below are the standard parameters for our arjun bark powder. Full details are given in the product specification sheet:
  • Botanical Name: Terminalia arjuna
  • Part Used: Stem Bark
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh
  • Moisture Content: < 8.0%
  • Processing: Fine milled
  • Appearance: Fine brown to light brown powder
  • Flavor Profile: Characteristic astringent and bitter taste

Applications Across Industries

Arjun bark has a long history of use in Ayurvedic and herbal formulations. Today, supplement brands fill it into capsules and tablets. Tea and beverage companies add it to traditional herbal tea blends. Extract manufacturers use it as a raw material for further processing. Some cosmetic formulators also include it in herbal topical products. Our buyers include nutraceutical companies, herbal extract manufacturers, Ayurvedic brands and functional food developers. If you need a different particle size or your own pack format, tell us your requirement. OEM and private label packing is available.

Buyer FAQ: Everything You Need to Know

What is the minimum order quantity for arjun bark powder exporter orders?

Our MOQ is 5 Kg. This works well for samples, pilot runs and first commercial orders, and we scale up for larger shipments.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack in food-grade pouches, HDPE drums and export bulk bags. Stored cool and dry, away from direct sunlight, the shelf life is 24 months.

How do I request a sample or quote?

Send us your specification, quantity and destination. Samples are available on request. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Partner with Tradenest Naturals

Choosing a supplier affects your own reputation with customers. Tradenest Naturals offers clear specifications, responsive communication and export documentation support for every shipment. We ship worldwide from India. Contact us to discuss your bulk arjun bark powder requirements.
